//: Race-tile cameras (P1-R05), format jj.framing.v1. The chase presets, first person and its mirror are seeded from the design POC's framing (art/ui/poc/shared/framing.json, P1-U05.2, R98) and are TUNE values until the owner accepts the POC at G-DESIGN. Distances in metres from the car's origin (on the ground between the axles). `rig` holds the host's own tuning: the spring that follows the chase point, speed-scaled look-ahead, the pull-in when a barrier or building hides the car, the first-person comfort limits and speed FOV kick. `byCount` is the host's default distance by the number of players on screen (mid at every count, as the POC frames it, until playtests pick per count); each player may override it for their tile. The first-person eye sits further forward than the POC's (1.05 m, not 0.45 m) because the baked Cruz Missile's bonnet is higher than the POC car's: at 0.45 m it filled 40 % of the tile. Nothing here caps anything.
